title: Eldergrove clearing grass and moss
subject: Subject: the floor of a clearing in an ancient wood, about 3 m across, seen from above. Dark green grass and clover, soft patches of moss, a few bare earth gaps and a scatter of tiny white clover flowers spread evenly. Cooler and mossier than an open meadow. Night, under a bright full moon: cool silver-lavender moonlight, plum-indigo shadows, but the texture itself evenly lit.
use: The ground of the Eldergrove clearing fight.

title: Clover and tall grass tuft
subject: Subject: one tuft of wild clover with small round white flower heads and a few tall thin grass blades, about 35 cm across and 30 cm high. Dark green leaves catching silver moonlight on top.
use: Scattered round the edges of the Eldergrove clearing.

title: Ancient first-age tree with glowing hollows
subject: Subject: one enormous ancient tree from the first age of the world, whole, about 30 m high. A vast twisted trunk of grey-violet bark made of many fused roots, with arches between the roots at its foot and two or three hollows in the trunk where small warm ember lights glow; a huge spreading crown of dark green leaf clusters. Night, under a bright full moon: cool silver-lavender moonlight, plum-indigo shadows; only the hollows are warm.
use: The great trees round the Eldergrove clearing fight, placed at the clearing's back and sides.

title: Ancient tree bark
subject: Subject: the bark of an enormous ancient tree, seen flat, about 1.5 m across. Thick twisted ridges of grey-violet bark running mostly up and down like fused roots, deep dark grooves between them, a little moss in the grooves. Night colours.
use: The trunks and roots of Eldergrove's ancient trees.

title: Ruined first-age stone arches
subject: Subject: a ruined stone wall of the first age, seen flat from the front: two tall pointed arched openings side by side and a lower broken third arch, in old grey-lavender stone, thick moss and ivy hanging over the top and down the sides, ferns at the foot. About 6 m high. No roof.
use: Ruins standing in the wood at the edge of the Eldergrove clearing.
